title: Ramification index one descends to finite subfields
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ. Let E and D be finite-dimensional intermediate fields of Ω/ℚ with D contained in E, and let q be a natural prime. Suppose every prime ideal of O_E above (q) has ramification index one over ℤ. Then every prime ideal of O_D above (q) also has ramification index one over ℤ. Neither field is required to be Galois over ℚ.
lean_statement: ∀ (E D : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ D] (q : ℕ), q.Prime → D ≤ E → (∀ P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E), P.IsPrime → P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}) → Ideal.ramificationIdx P ℤ = 1) → ∀ R : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers D), R.IsPrime → R.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}) → Ideal.ramificationIdx R ℤ = 1
